params._hasher: Poseidon(2) hasher (must match the circuit's Poseidon)

params._token: the ERC-20 held by the vault

deposit(uint256).details: Caller must approve the vault for `denomination` first.

withdraw(uint256[2],uint256[2][2],uint25.details: Public inputs must be ordered exactly as the circuit declares them:      [root, nullifierHash, recipient, relayer, fee].

hashLeftRight(uint256,uint256).notice: Poseidon hash of an ordered pair, via the on-chain hasher.

isKnownRoot(uint256).notice: True if `_root` is among the last ROOT_HISTORY_SIZE roots.

userdoc.notice: A zero-knowledge shielded vault for a fixed-denomination ERC-20. Deposit: post a commitment = Poseidon(nullifier, secret); it becomes the next Merkle leaf. Withdraw: prove, in zero knowledge, that your commitment is a leaf under a known recent root — revealing only the root and the nullifier hash, never which deposit. A relayer may submit the withdrawal and take `fee` from the amount. Research / educational. Testnet only.
